images.title: Three shapes that tile the plane
images.purpose: Show patches of square, equilateral triangle and regular hexagon tilings, with the angles at one corner.
images.composition: Three equal panels side by side.
exact_structure: Left panel: a patch of 3 by 3 squares in teal (#0072B2); at one inner corner, 4 squares meet, with the label 4 × 90° = 360°.
Middle panel: a patch of equilateral triangles in amber (#E69F00); at one inner corner, 6 triangles meet, with the label 6 × 60° = 360°.
Right panel: a patch of 7 regular hexagons in green (#009E73) (one in the middle, 6 round it); at one corner, 3 hexagons meet, with the label 3 × 120° = 360°.
In each panel, the shared corner is marked with a small reddish purple (#CC79A7) dot.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: At every corner of a tiling the angles add to 360°.

image_decisions.why: The corner condition is seen best when the three tilings sit side by side.
